title: Request Enforcement, Dotted FLS & Cache Eviction Sequence
intro: Follow a single API request from the Next.js client through cold-warmed TenantContextMiddleware, live feature verification, dotted FLS redaction, and atomic post-commit cache invalidation.
outro: Stale JWTs and 30-second cached principals are invalidated the moment a feature override or subscription commits.

scenes.title: 1. Cross-Tenant Cold-Cache Warm & Live Feature Gate

points.title: Inbound Request with X-Tenant-Context
points.text: The frontend submits GET /crm/opportunities alongside X-Tenant-Context to enter a target tenant workspace.
points.caption: Inbound CRM read carries target tenant header

points.title: Cold-Cache Warm Before Validation
points.text: TenantContextMiddleware warms AdminPermissionCache if empty and loads target MembershipMode effective permissions and FLS before rejecting context access.
points.caption: Prevents false 403s immediately after cache eviction

points.title: MFA -> UseAuthorization -> Live Feature Gate
points.text: After RequireMfaEnrollmentMiddleware, PermissionAuthorizationHandler invokes live IFeatureChecker.IsEnabledAsync(TargetTenant, CRM.Enabled), stopping stale JWTs and PATs with 403.
points.caption: Live Entitlements check rejects disabled modules

points.title: Canonical Key & Intersect/Union Redaction
points.text: FLS & Export Guard resolves crm.opportunities cleanly, intersects read-capable role masks, unions additive UserGroup caps, and returns masked JSON or CsvFormulaGuard-neutralized exports.
points.caption: Identical FLS protection for JSON APIs and downloads

points.title: DB Commit Before Cache & Pool Sync
points.text: Toggling CRM.Enabled = false commits EntitlementsDbContext first, invalidates FeatureCache, and triggers SubscriptionChanged pool sync without deleting custom RolePermissions.
points.caption: Database truth commits before cache clear

points.title: Principal Stamp Bump & Immediate 403
points.text: Evicting AdminPermissionCache and bumping admin:principal:* stamps ensures subsequent calls using an older JWT fail immediately with 403 Forbidden.
points.caption: Stale token rejected without waiting for TTL expiry
